scope: Only P2 psi enters profile errors; degree one is excluded and its angular-momentum constraint is reported separately.
time_matching: Saved times agree to floating-point precision; no interpolation or phase fitting.
distance_normalization: Energy-equivalent error = sqrt(n(n+1)/2)*||delta a_n||/sqrt(E_A); retains amplitude and remains defined when the degree is initially absent.
warnings: Pointwise turbulent trajectories can decorrelate; long-time refinement also requires statistical comparisons across seeds and ages.
